Traditional RL-based NM methods typically use fixed preferences to optimize multiple objectives like quality of service (QoS) and computing resource usage. However, in real-world scenarios, preferences of the multiple objectives can be changed dynamically due to factors such as network overloads or server failures. We present a method that allows RL agents to adapt to dynamic preferences during testing.
